units.source_text: 只因爱子情深，以致心思迷乱，竟不能亲送出境了！”

en.t: It was only because his love for his child was so deep that his mind had become confused, and in the end he could not personally see her off beyond the border!

units.source_text: 又向公子请一个安，央求道：“

en.t: Then he bowed respectfully to the young lord again and pleaded,

units.source_text: 请恕我谈及儿女之情：公子倘有思念小女之时，务请惠赐玉音！”

en.t: Please forgive me for speaking of a parent's feelings for his child: if there are times when you think of my daughter, I beg you to favor her with a message!

units.source_text: 公子听了这话十分伤心，两颊都哭红了，容姿美不可言。

en.t: When the young lord heard these words he was deeply saddened; both his cheeks were red from weeping, and his beauty was beyond description.

units.source_text: 答道：“已结不解之缘，岂能忘怀？

en.t: He replied, We have already formed a bond that cannot be undone; how could I ever forget?

units.source_text: 不久你自会明白我的心迹。

en.t: Before long, you will understand my true feelings for yourself.

units.source_text: 只是这个住处，使我难于舍弃，如之奈何！”

en.t: Only this dwelling makes it hard for me to leave it behind; what am I to do?
